dog.description_text:
Hi, I'm Justice! I'm a 6 month old kitten who was rescued at 9 weeks old, and I have been waiting for my forever home each and every day. Most kittens my age have more confidence than I do, I'll admit I am still very scared, and it takes time for me to build trust. I was given the chance to stay here at the rescue, instead of just being neutered and put back on the street where nothing felt safe.
Justice is a shy, sweetheart who just needs to be given another chance. He is looking for a home who will accept him as he is, and give him the safety, love, and confidence boost he needs to flourish. He is great with other kittens and cats!
dog.name: Justice
